g.aria-label: Total output current includes the feedback path: io = vo/RL + vo/(R1 + R2).
g.title: Total output current includes the feedback path: io = vo/RL + vo/(R1 + R2).
g.desc: Mathematical notation: Total output current includes the feedback path: i_o=\frac{v_o}{R_L}+\frac{v_o}{R_1+R_2}.
